faces.name: Strixhaven Film Student
faces.oracleText: Whenever a legendary creature you control deals combat damage to a player, Strixhaven Film Student becomes prepared.

faces.name: Cut
faces.oracleText: Cut deals 4 damage to target creature.

faces.name: Strixhaven Rivalry
faces.oracleText:
When you planeswalk here, each player enrolls in a Strixhaven college for as long this plane remains face up.
Whenever you cast a spell that shares a color with your college, put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature.
Whenever chaos ensues, double the number of each kind of counter on any number of target permanents you control.

faces.name: Strixhaven Skycoach
faces.oracleText:
Flying
When this Vehicle enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Crew 2 (Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 2 or more: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.)

faces.name: Strixhaven Stadium
faces.oracleText:
{T}: Add {C}. Put a point counter on this artifact.
Whenever a creature deals combat damage to you, remove a point counter from this artifact.
Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, put a point counter on this artifact. Then if it has ten or more point counters on it, remove them all and that player loses the game.

faces.name: Strix Lookout
faces.oracleText:
Flying, vigilance (Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.)
{1}{U}, {T}: Draw a card, then discard a card.

faces.name: Strix Serenade
faces.oracleText: Counter target artifact, creature, or planeswalker spell. Its controller creates a 2/2 blue Bird creature token with flying.
